plan.title: Muscle treated vs control: limma-trend DE + camera enrichment
plan.analytical_narrative: The core facility delivered log2(TPM+1) values for 12 muscle samples (6 treated, 6 control, single batch, unpaired). Because the input is already normalized log-scale expression and not raw counts, no count-based model (DESeq2/edgeR) applies; the grounded procedure is a limma-trend linear model. The flow is: (1) QC sample structure on the log matrix (PCA/MDS, sample distances, detected-gene counts) to catch any outlier or batch-like structure before modeling; (2) low-expression filtering on mean log expression using the smallest group size (6) as the presence threshold; (3) an explicit design with control set as the reference level and a named contrast (treated - control), fit with limma eBayes(trend=TRUE, robust=TRUE) to protect against hypervariable genes; (4) BH-adjusted topTable results, selecting genes at adj.P.Val < 0.05, reporting the number of genes tested and the number differentially expressed; (5) gene identifier annotation with org.Hs.eg.db and the reference-store NCBI human gene table, plus a tissue-identity sanity check of the top-expressed genes against muscle-enriched genes from the HPA/GTEx reference (skeletal muscle, since the declared tissue is 'muscle'); (6) camera competitive gene-set testing directly on the limma fit (inter.gene.cor=NA) against MSigDB Hallmark and WikiPathways human gene sets, which correctly accounts for inter-gene correlation and is the enrichment method the knowledge check approved for this design (a preranked fgsea run was flagged as not permitted for this situation and was replaced); (7) a final reproducibility report bundling session info, package versions, design/contrast definitions, thresholds, and gene counts. No count-model reference data (e.g. tx2gene) is needed since inputs are already log2 expression; all reference files used (MSigDB Hallmark human, WikiPathways human, NCBI human gene table, HPA proteinatlas, GTEx v8) are confirmed present in the store.

None - already normalized log2(TPM+1); value range check only
Explicit factor reference level (control), named contrast treated-control
limma-trend eBayes(trend=TRUE, robust=TRUE) on log2 values
BH adjustment via topTable(adjust.method='BH'), select by adj.P.Val < 0.05
Map gene identifiers with org.Hs.eg.db and NCBI gene info table
fgsea preranked on limma moderated-t statistic against MSigDB Hallmark and WikiPathways human gene sets
Reproducibility report: sessionInfo, package versions, design, thresholds, n_tested, n_de
